# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. This major release consolidates over a year of v4 preview work: variable font support, animated WebP encoding, color font palettes, and a deterministic singleton lifecycle. It is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **SKPaint text/font members removed** — Font-related members on SKPaint (Typeface, TextSize, TextScaleX, and related text-state APIs) obsoleted in v3 are now compile errors. Move typeface and text sizing onto SKFont. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **new SKFont() now carries an empty typeface** — Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty, so MeasureText and Draw produce nothing. Pass an explicit typeface: new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect 'no typeface' with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of == null.
- **new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null** — SKPaint.Typeface is SKTypeface.Default on creation, not null. Text drawing still works; code testing paint.Typeface == null to detect 'unset' must switch to paint.Typeface.IsEmpty.
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns Default on all platforms when the family is missing** — Android previously returned null for an unknown family. All platforms now return SKTypeface.Default. For strict null semantics use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(), which still returns null on no match.
- **SKStream.Move(long) throws OverflowException and is obsolete** — The native offset is 32-bit. Values outside int range now throw OverflowException instead of silently truncating. Call Move(int) and clamp or validate large offsets before the call.
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instances** — Ganesh requires Vulkan 1.1. On a Vulkan 1.0 instance the native layer calls SK_ABORT — not a managed exception, so it cannot be caught. Set both VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to VK_API_VERSION_1_1. Leaving MaxAPIVersion at 0 is unsafe.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are gone upstream. Replace fExtensions with fVkExtensions and fFeatures with fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2; delete the remaining three with no replacement.
- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo type changed; GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value equality** — The property type changed from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, and the old type no longer implements IEquatable. Update variable declarations and remove == comparisons on the old type.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed** — The protected setter was an implementation detail never intended for subclasses. Subclasses that assigned this property must be updated; the getter remains readable.

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestone m148** — Rolls up m132, m133, m147, and m148 plus stability patches from each, bringing upstream rendering fixes, improved text shaping, and groundwork for the new GPU pipeline. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable font support** — Full variable font axis enumeration and value control via SKFont and HarfBuzzSharp, including font-family matching by variation axes and robust handling of edge-case axis values. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — SKWebpEncoder now supports writing animated WebP sequences, enabling frame-by-frame animated image output at configurable quality and timing. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Color font palette support** — Color fonts (COLR/CPAL) can now have their palette selected and customized via SKFont, enabling rich emoji and decorative glyph rendering. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data access** — New SKStream.GetData() returns the underlying SKData without copying, useful for efficient stream-to-memory transfers where a copy would be wasteful. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions on SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface** — Pass explicit sampling filters when compositing surfaces, giving finer control over image quality vs. performance trade-offs. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HarfBuzzSharp: HBColor struct and new API wrappers** — Added the HBColor struct for proper hb_color_t representation, filled in missing API wrappers, and corrected naming-convention violations across the HarfBuzz bindings. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi static constructor** — The native-library version-mismatch check that previously ran in a [ModuleInitializer] now runs in the SkiaApi static constructor, making the failure deterministic and easier to diagnose at startup. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and axis corrected** — GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes (not Width×bytesPerPixel) for stride, and the x,y overload used Height instead of Width to compute the offset — both producing wrong pixel addresses on non-tight bitmaps. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash fixed** — When SKPath and its parent SKPathBuilder were GC-collected in reverse order the finalizer crashed. The correct keep-alive pattern is now used. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default typeface resolution fixed on Android API 36+** — SKTypeface.Default now resolves through the font manager with an empty-typeface fallback, preventing process termination on Android API 36+ where the old native path returned null. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **WinUI: Projection DLL not found on .NET 9 fixed** — WinUI consumers on .NET 9 saw a DLL-load failure at startup. The correct projection assembly is now resolved for all target frameworks. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **SKGLView restores rendering after tab switch in MAUI** — On MAUI TabBar, SKGLView stopped rendering after switching away and back. The GL context lifecycle is now correctly restored on re-attach. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked for deterministic disposal** — The internal singleton pattern used by native handles is redesigned so that disposal ordering is deterministic, preventing use-after-free crashes in long-running applications. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic native assets added** — SkiaSharp now ships native libraries built against the Bionic libc, enabling use in environments without a standard glibc — notably older Android-NDK-based runtimes. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds** — Two new Tizen target architectures are now built and shipped, expanding .NET on Tizen platform coverage. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple TFMs corrected: versioned for libraries, unversioned for apps** — Apple TFMs now use versioned monikers (ios16.0, maccatalyst14.0, …) for library packages and unversioned ones for app projects, aligning with .NET conventions. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **WASM: pre-.NET 8 Emscripten builds dropped** — Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions below the .NET 8 minimum are no longer produced, reducing artifact size and build time. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **C# 13 language support on legacy TFMs via PolySharp** — PolySharp is added as a build dependency to polyfill C# 13 language features on .NET Standard and older TFMs. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3642](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3642))

## Security

- **Native dependency refresh** — libpng → 1.6.58, libexpat → 2.7.5 and 2.8.1, freetype → 2.14.3, zlib → 1.3.2.1-motley, libjpeg-turbo → 3.1.4.1, and HarfBuzz → 14.2.0. ([#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Updated to HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0, adding the HBColor struct for proper hb_color_t representation and filling in missing API wrappers with corrected naming conventions.
